## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the relevant commands and results, or explain what could not be checked.

## Data and interpretation

If the change affects statistics, state the population, formula, denominator, NULL
behavior, and any effect on existing outputs. Explain any source-snapshot or
manifest change explicitly. Otherwise, say that analytical outputs are unchanged.

- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, local caches, or generated frontend bundles.
- [ ] Definitions and documentation match any behavioral change.
- [ ] Any changed frozen input or checkpoint has an explicit provenance explanation.
